  PROBLEM: The fragment says the handoff's `--last-green-json` is used only "when the reproduction cache was not used". The same fragment also says "its baseline replaces any reproduction-cache copy", and scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:3656-3659 always overwrites `${suspect_dir}/last_green.json` from the handoff when the handoff matches. The fragment therefore contradicts itself and the code.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but this contractual fragment gives operators the wrong baseline source when they read `suspect_commits ... last_green=cached` lines. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:7087-7104,7303-7328; scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:3379-3390,3646-3662 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A failed, malformed or behind P4 compare makes `heal_suspect_scope` return `handoff=None`. Reproduction then makes a fresh `last-green-run` GET and `_heal_build_suspect_commits` fetches the compare again.
  WHY: With the trend switch also on, a report costs P4 2 + reproduction 1 + P3 compare 1 + slow-day commits 1 + trend 6 = 11 calls, above the documented "P3 plus P4 stays at most 9 calls per report". `test_intake_suspect_scope_with_trend_keeps_the_p3_budget` pins the ≤9 sum only on the success path. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:3379-3387,3649-3659 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: No test covers either new handoff-reuse behaviour: reproduction taking its last-green result from the handoff in `_heal_run_reproduction`, or the handoff baseline overriding a cached reproduction result (including cached `request_failed`) in `_heal_build_suspect_commits`.
  WHY: `_run_p4_intake` never sets `WORKFLOW_HEAL_REPRODUCE_ENABLED=true`, and the reproduce replays (around lines 11128 and 11471) never set `WORKFLOW_HEAL_SUSPECT_SCOPE_ENABLED`. Drift in the jq key match (for example `suspect_branch` vs `HEAD_BRANCH`) would silently bring back an extra GET or pick a different baseline, and CI would not notice. Both reviewers rated it NIT.

- agents.d/heal-suspect-scope.md:Line 2, the sentence "`_heal_build_suspect_commits` reuses it when every key matches (`--last-green-json` when the reproduction cache was not used, and the new `suspect-commits --compare-json` ...)". Compare scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh lines 3656-3659 in `_heal_build_suspect_commits`. | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When the handoff matches, `_heal_build_suspect_commits` now always overwrites `${suspect_dir}/last_green.json` with the handoff's `.last_green`, even after the reproduction-cache branch (lines 3639-3645) wrote it. The fragment still says "when the reproduction cache was not used" and also says "its baseline replaces any reproduction-cache copy", so it contradicts itself and the code.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but operators reading `suspect_commits ... last_green=cached` get the wrong precedence. Suggested fix is a one-clause edit, for example "(`--last-green-json`, whose file the handoff's baseline overwrites, ...)".
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:`_heal_run_reproduction`, lines 3379-3387 (new handoff-reuse branch); `_heal_build_suspect_commits`, lines 3649-3659 (handoff overrides the reproduction cache). | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: No test covers either new behaviour: reproduction taking last-green from the handoff (the match depends on raw `HEAD_BRANCH` equalling the validated branch stored in the handoff), or the handoff baseline overriding a cached reproduction result, including cached `request_failed`. `_run_p4_intake` never sets `WORKFLOW_HEAL_REPRODUCE_ENABLED=true`, and the replays that do (around lines 11128 and 11471) never set `WORKFLOW_HEAL_SUSPECT_SCOPE_ENABLED`.
  WHY: Key drift between the jq programs or the `last_green` shapes would silently bring back the extra GET or pick a different baseline. Suggested coverage: one `_run_p4_intake` case with both switches on, asserting a single `/actions/workflows/` call and `reproduction ... baseline=ok`.
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. All deliverables are present. Self-repo-only narrowing is documented.
- Notes on gate failures (not findings): test_label_contract_and_reporter_skip reads the missing `.github/ai/label_contract.v1.json`, and the ordering at lines 1873/1878 still holds. test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py already allowlists `workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml`. The copilot HTTP 422 `custom_instructions_too_large` failure is external.
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py `_cmd_suspect_scope` outer `except Exception:` resets `calls` to 0, which goes against the `helper_failed ... calls=<n>` contract. Suggested fix: `summary = dict(failed, calls=summary.get("calls", 0) if isinstance(summary, dict) else 0); paths, handoff = [], None` (1-2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
